name: round_number_reversal_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY approaches a 100-point psychological level (22000, 22100, 22200, etc.), short call writers at that strike must sell NIFTY futures to maintain delta neutrality as gamma spikes — creating mechanical resistance as price rises toward the level. Symmetrically, short put writers buy NIFTY as it falls toward their strike, creating a mechanical demand floor. Retail traders simultaneously cluster limit orders and stop-losses at these round numbers (anchoring bias), so when NIFTY arrives at a 100-multiple with 2-minute RSI at an extreme (oversold near support, overbought near resistance) and 1-minute momentum waning, the combined mechanical delta-hedging demand plus order-book absorption generates a 10-15 spot point reversal over the next 30-90 seconds.

indicators.name: nearest_100
indicators.purpose: Major psychological level for NIFTY — option strikes are at 50-pt intervals, so 100-multiples represent double-density option OI clusters (both 22000 and 22100 are listed strikes); these carry the largest delta-hedging flows from market makers

indicators.name: dist_to_100
indicators.purpose: Signed distance: positive = above the level (approaching from support side), negative = below (approaching resistance). Used to confirm directional exhaustion.

indicators.name: mom_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute (12 × 5s) momentum. Original used 5-bar 1-min momentum (5 min) — compressed to 1 min because we're detecting the FINAL push into the level (last 60 seconds of the approach), not the multi-minute directional move.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI (24 bars × 5s). Original used RSI(7) on 1-min bars = 7-minute window. Compressed to 2 minutes because we're catching the FAST microstructure exhaustion AT the level, not the slow recovery. RSI(24) has enough bars to be meaningful at 5s but short enough to detect the immediate overbought/oversold condition at the round number.

conditions: rsi_24 < rsi_oversold (default 35): short-term exhaustion of selling
buy_ce.confirmation: All three conditions on same 5-second bar

conditions: rsi_24 > rsi_overbought (default 65): short-term exhaustion of buying
buy_pe.confirmation: All three conditions on same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 spot points adverse move. If NIFTY moves 8 pts beyond the round number level (i.e., the level fails as support/resistance), the delta-hedging mechanical flow has been overwhelmed and the reversal thesis is wrong. 8 spot pts is below the noise threshold for a 30-second NIFTY move (2-5 pts typical) but above intraday tick noise.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points = ~12 spot points in the reversal direction. NIFTY bounces off major round levels typically cover 10-20 spot points in 30-90 seconds (the initial delta-hedging impulse). Targeting 12 pts captures the lower end of this range at 1:1.5 R:R, appropriate for a 55-60% win-rate reversal setup.

filters.vix_filter: none (VIX not used — round number mechanics persist across volatility regimes)
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST, session_start skips first 5 min of open noise
filters.trend_filter: none — reversal strategy intentionally trades counter to momentum
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — anchoring bias and delta-hedging mechanics are structural, not statistical artifacts; round number clustering is persistent in Indian retail and HFT behavior

adaptation_notes: Original trades individual NIFTY50 stocks where round numbers are stock-price-specific (₹500, ₹1000, ₹2000 for different stocks). On NIFTY index, the equivalent is 100-point multiples: these are the intersection points where two adjacent 50-pt option strikes coincide, creating maximum option OI concentration and the strongest delta-hedging mechanical flows. The lookback was compressed 7x (from RSI(7) on 1-min to RSI(24) on 5s) rather than the naive 12x (RSI(84)) because the thesis is about catching the FAST 30-90 second microstructure reversal — not the slow multi-minute recovery that the original captured. Stops and targets are calibrated to 30-90 second NIFTY option moves (2-5 pts at 30s, 3-7 pts at 60s), not to the original's percentage-based equity stops.
weaknesses: When NIFTY breaks through a 100-multiple with conviction (news-driven, large institutional directional order), the reversal bet fails hard — opposite of normal. No reliable way to distinguish conviction breaks from tests.
During low-volatility compression, NIFTY may oscillate around a round number for minutes, generating multiple signals in the same direction — max_trades_per_day cap critical.
Stop-hunting is common at major NIFTY round levels (HFTs know orders cluster there) — entries near the level can be caught by a stop-hunt through the level before reversal.
